title: Deliverect orders
subtitle: Every order Deliverect sent us: what became of it, the last status we sent back, and the failures to retry.

alert.hint: The delivery platform cancelled this order after the store had invoiced it. We told Deliverect the cancel failed; someone has to settle it with the platform and the store.

retry.title: Retry this order

notes.refused: Order <order>{{order}}</order> was refused. Retrying runs it again: if the reason has cleared, it becomes a document and Deliverect is told it is accepted.
notes.statusFailed: The last status call for order <order>{{order}}</order> failed. Retrying sends it to Deliverect again.

retry.doneDetail: Order {{order}} was retried. Its row shows what became of it.
retry.notFailed: This order is not in a failed state, so there is nothing to retry. Its row may already have changed.
